# Ilan's Online Attic

> Personal website of Ilan Yashuk — a programmer-athlete from Israel sharing blog posts, photography, and projects.

## Blog

Posts about technology, programming, philosophy, books, travel, and competitive sports training. Written in English and Hebrew.

- [Blog index](https://www.ilansonlineattic.com/writing)

Topics: training, philosophy, books, travel, code

## Projects

Software projects built over the years — web apps, mobile apps, and tools. Includes Promreach (AI agent app), CalendarPlusAI, Visuathlete (athlete analytics), EL-ON, and SafeCloud.

- [Projects page](https://www.ilansonlineattic.com/projects)

## Photography

Personal photo gallery — hiking, cycling, travel, track & field, and daily life.

- [Photos](https://www.ilansonlineattic.com/images)

## About

Ilan Yashuk, born 2004. Full-stack developer (Next.js, React Native, Nuxt, Python, Flask) and competitive track & field athlete (100m: 11.21s, Long Jump: 6.75m).

- [About](https://www.ilansonlineattic.com)
